0022600105.text: The Nets (0-1, last ten 0-1 after a loss) sit fourth in the Atlantic, one game back, and 10th in the East, while the Cavaliers have no 2026-27 record yet. Cleveland won all three meetings last season, including a 106-102 victory in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026. Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder), and Cleveland is missing Khalifa Diop (knee) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back).
